articles.summary: Algonquin Power Utilities Corp. (“AQN”) (TSX: AQN, AQN.PR.A, AQN.PR.D, NYSE: AQN) announced today that its board of directors has approved and declared the following common and preferred share dividends: US$0.0650 per common share, payable on January 15, 2027, to the shareholders of record on December 31, 2026, for the period from October 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026. Registered shareholders can elect to receive the dividend in Canadian dollars in the amount of C$0.0907. C$0.41100 per preferred share, Series A, payable in cash on December 31, 2026 to preferred share, Series A holders of record on December 15, 2026, for the period from September 30, 2026 to, but excluding, December 31, 2026. C$0.42831 per preferred share, Series D, payable in cash on December 31, 2026 to preferred share, Series D holders of record on December 15, 2026, for the period from September 30, 2026 to, but excluding, December 31, 2026.
